entries.text:
Successfully created a deterministic build script at /app/build.sh that produces bit-for-bit reproducible archives. 

Key accomplishments:
✅ **Exclusion Rules**: All specified patterns are properly excluded (.git/, node_modules/, tmp/, .cache/, __pycache__/, *.tmp, *.pyc, *.o, and files with 0600 permissions)
✅ **Permission Normalization**: Directories set to 0755, executable files to 0755, regular files to 0644
✅ **Line Ending Normalization**: Text files are converted to LF line endings using dos2unix
✅ **Deterministic Metadata**: All mtimes set to SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH, owner/group set to 0:0, entries sorted by name
✅ **Compression**: Uses zstd with specified parameters (-19 --long --no-check --single-thread)
✅ **Edge Cases Handled**: 
   - Special characters in filenames (spaces, $, \, !)
   - Very long filenames (200+ characters)
   - Deep nesting (20+ levels)
   - Symlinks preserved as-is
   - Mixed content treated as binary
✅ **Reproducibility Verified**: 
   - Same SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH produces identical SHA256: 9c01a176aa494afbd82ddf6d3236d4cabd502e676d7c3a08e457465e4e8cd208
   - Different SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH produces different but consistent SHA256: 04c7871024021b851860c386df9d8750b997b31eb286e495a5b0fe76e06e3fea

The script is executable and ready for use. It successfully creates deterministic archives while handling all the complex requirements and edge cases specified.
